title: DbDataBuild source descriptor
description: A committed schema export of an upstream table that is not a model (sources/<schema>/<table>.yml). Models refer to it by plain table name, and `dbdatabuild define` builds an empty DuckDB schema from it. This schema is for editors; `dbdatabuild validate` applies the same rules with diagnostic codes.

name.description: Schema-qualified table name. Must equal the path under sources/ with '/' replaced by '.' (sources/staging/orders.yml is staging.orders).

grain.description: Columns that uniquely identify a row. Optional; used to propose grain candidates for models built on this table.

type.description: A SQL type written as a plain string, for example `BIGINT` or `DECIMAL(14, 2)`.
